name: GS-100 salvage ship
description: The GS-100 salvage ship was a salvage freighter, the ship design included multiple arms that could pick up debris from space battles. The scavenger Gha Nachkt owned one such ship, the Vulture's Claw, during the Clone Wars. In 3 ABY, a GS-100 was approved to depart from Hauler's Keep in the Khepi system.
